assessment.what_changed_en: Replaces the opening geographic definition of Karelia as an area in eastern Fennoscandia with a wider five-waterway boundary formula while keeping the existing Kotus citation attached.
assessment.uncertainty_note: The named waterways do border parts of Karelia, so the dispute concerns whether the added boundary formula matches the cited scholarly definition.
assessment.historical_note_en: Definitions of Karelia vary between Finnish historical provinces, the Republic of Karelia, and broader cultural-linguistic regions.
